acquisition_backlog.goal: Verify Lute's exact current skill names, effects, and status applications.
acquisition_backlog.data_needed: Current in-game or official Lute skill wording
acquisition_backlog.collection_method: Capture current skill screen and source metadata, or cite official current material.
acquisition_backlog.validation_method: Run evidence wrapper and reference-integrity gates against skill and status records.
acquisition_backlog.completion_criteria: All required Skill fields have source, evidence level, game version, last_verified, public_allowed, and editorial judgment metadata.
acquisition_backlog.unblock_condition: Lute Skill layer moves from INCOMPLETE to READY_FOR_REVIEW.

acquisition_backlog.goal: Verify Lute's relevant Karma and Equipment relation before build readiness.
acquisition_backlog.data_needed: Current Lute exclusive/compatible Karma and equipment set relation
acquisition_backlog.collection_method: Capture current game collection/build screens or official collection records.
acquisition_backlog.validation_method: Validate canonical Karma/Equipment IDs and evidence wrappers.
acquisition_backlog.completion_criteria: At least one Karma or Equipment relation is evidence-complete and references Lute without copied facts.
acquisition_backlog.unblock_condition: Equipment/Karma layer moves from INCOMPLETE to RESEARCH_READY or READY_FOR_REVIEW.

acquisition_backlog.goal: Validate whether the Lute -> Roxy -> Theresia chain exists in current gameplay.

acquisition_backlog.collection_method: Reproduce the chain in-game or with validated current data and capture status trigger evidence.
acquisition_backlog.validation_method: Run reference-integrity gate for character, skill, status, and team_relation IDs.
acquisition_backlog.completion_criteria: Both directed relation candidates resolve canonical refs and carry current version evidence.
acquisition_backlog.unblock_condition: Team Relation layer moves from INCOMPLETE to RESEARCH_READY or READY_FOR_REVIEW.
